claims.content: The Business Owner analyzes auction business performance by viewing reports that present sales and inventory metrics and customer segmentation insights.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The Business Owner analyzes auction business performance by viewing reports that present sales and inventory metrics and customer segmentation insights.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The Business Owner views a sales report showing Gross Product, Return Amount, Net Revenue, COGS, GM%, and Cash Recovery across retail categories such as Jewelry, Gemstones, and Collectibles.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The Business Owner initiates an auction business performance analysis by accessing the relevant performance report.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The Business Owner has viewed the selected business performance report with the relevant auction business metrics.
in_scope_actions: View a sales performance report with sales metrics across retail categories.
View an inventory performance and aging report with item status and SKU/cost metrics.
Use analysis reports to understand customer base behavior and focus segmentation efforts.
excluded_adjacent_actions: Adjacent auction administration functions not required to view performance reports.
Upstream data-entry processes and downstream actions taken after the analysis.
variant_dimensions: Report type: sales performance, inventory performance and aging, customer segmentation

claims.content: Business Owner
The user is authenticated to the Auction Administration application as an 'Auctioneer'.
The auction platform has a supporting database, separate from the enterprise, containing tables for Current Inventory, Current Bidding Data, Historical Bidding Data, Orders, and Customer Data.

covered_aspect_ids: system state: existence of separate supporting database
required data domains: inventory, bidding, orders, customer data

claims.content: The Business Owner accesses a performance report page, such as the Sales Report, Inventory Performance & Aging Report, or Customer Ranking Report, from the Auction Admin Main Menu Page to begin analyzing auction business performance.

covered_aspect_ids: trigger event: access report from main menu
entry point: Auction Admin Main Menu Page

claims.content: The Business Owner selects the Sales Report from the Reports Menu on the Auction Admin Main Menu Page by clicking the labeled 'GO' button next to Sales Report.
The system displays the Sales Report page.
The Business Owner selects a date range by entering a Start Date and an End Date in the respective fields.
The Business Owner clicks the 'Submit' button to generate the report with the selected parameters.
The system generates and displays the Sales Report with Gross Product, Return Amount, Net Revenue, COGS, GM%, and Cash Recovery across retail categories such as Jewelry, Gemstones, and Collectibles.
The Business Owner views the Sales Report metrics to analyze auction business performance.

covered_aspect_ids: view inventory performance and aging report
canonical success scenario: view inventory report with filtered results
actor action: select filters and submit
system response: display tabular inventory data with specified metrics
report content structure: includes aging, cost, availability, quality scores

claims.content: Diverges from main flow Step 1: Instead of selecting the Sales Report, the Business Owner may select the Customer Ranking Report (accessible via a direct link from the Auction Admin Main Menu Page) to analyze customer segmentation and auction business performance.

Diverges from main flow Step 1: Instead of selecting the Sales Report, the Business Owner may select the RFM Report to analyze customer base behavior and segmentation as part of the performance analysis.

Diverges from main flow Step 1: Instead of selecting the Sales Report, the Business Owner may select the Inventory Performance & Aging Report and, in its criteria section, choose either 'Items currently online only' or 'All sellable auction inventory' via radio button options to scope the inventory results.

Diverges from main flow Step 1: Within the Inventory Performance & Aging Report selected instead of the Sales Report, the Business Owner may toggle radio buttons to view items with or without images and items with or without a valid (sellable) location.

Diverges from main flow Step 1: Within the Inventory Performance & Aging Report selected instead of the Sales Report, the Business Owner may group results by any of 11 predefined dimensions (e.g., Retail Category, Product Type, Gemstone, Material, Brand, J/G Score, Ring Size) via a scrolling list box, generating dynamic column outputs based on the selection.
Diverges from main flow Step 3: Instead of limiting the report to the past 12 months, the Business Owner may choose to generate a lifetime report using all available sales data.

covered_aspect_ids: alternative_flow: color-coded column headers for related data
grouping-dimension-alternatives: 11 selectable grouping criteria affecting output structure
